intro: The Cult's True Plans addresses the aftermath of a cult defector's untimely demise. With the informant dead and his secrets lost, investigators must consult with Talaanis Shadowsong to devise a new strategy against the cult.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The turncoat clearly was afraid of what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.
We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.

clips.title: Completion
paras: We could try and send peacekeepers to directly engage the cult forces, but we would not fare well against them in open battle.
We are going to need a different approach.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
